title: Accounts Receivable Rule: Open Utility Balance, Held Charges and the Undisputed Balance
content:
# Open Balance, Held Charges and the Undisputed Balance — Utility Services Program

**Rule.** On a Utility Services Program account:

1. The **open balance** of the account is the sum of every usage, allocation, flat and package overage line billed on it less every adjustment and payment posted on it, rounded half up to the cent.
2. The **held charges** are the charge of the bill line named by the most recent dispute in submitted status on the account, as billed.
3. The **undisputed balance** is the open balance less the held charges, rounded half up to the cent.

## Where each figure comes from

| Figure | Record |
|---|---|
| lines billed | the account's usage, allocation, flat (including package fee and setup fee) and package overage lines |
| amounts taken off | the account's adjustments and payments |
| the disputed line | the bill line named by the most recent dispute in submitted status, by its submission time |
| the ground of that dispute | the reason recorded on the dispute |
| the held charge | that line's amount as billed; its usage is the usage recorded on it |

Disputes in any status other than submitted do not name the held line.

## Worked example (hypothetical account)

Lines billed on the account total $312.40; adjustments total $0.00 and payments $150.00. The most recent submitted dispute names a water usage line billed at $88.20.

- Open balance: $312.40 less $150.00 is $162.40.
- Held charges: $88.20.
- Undisputed balance: $162.40 less $88.20 is $74.20.

*Second case (hypothetical):* two disputes are on the account, an older one in submitted status naming a $40.00 line and a newer one in submitted status naming a $55.00 line. The held charge is the $55.00 line named by the most recent one.
